written.headline: Mistral releases Voxtral 3 speech models and voice agent SDK
written.summary: Mistral AI released Voxtral 3, a family of speech-to-text and text-to-speech models alongside a voice agent SDK built on LiveKit. The system combines transcription, reasoning, and speech output into a streaming pipeline with sub-one-second turn latency priced at $0.04 per minute.
